topic: Propulsion system used in torpedo, power supply and control systems
syllabus_extract: Propulsion system used in torpedo, power supply and control systems
specific_objectives: 35.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain role of underwater weapons

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of propulsion diagrams and control circuit schematics; Safety: No live electrical components; Instructor supervision: Monitor diagram interpretation accuracy
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a torpedo?
Name two types of underwater weapons.
How does a torpedo differ from a surface missile?

development.content:
Types of torpedo propulsion systems
Chemical fuel cell operation principles
Electric motor drive mechanisms
Power supply battery configurations
Control system actuation methods

Thermal battery activation sequences
Hydraulic control line functions
Gyroscopic stabilization systems
Depth charge deployment mechanisms
Propeller pitch adjustment controls

topics: Integration of power and control units
development.content:
Integration of power and control units
Fail-safe mechanisms in propulsion
Signal transmission in control circuits
Maintenance requirements for power cells
Troubleshooting common control faults

summary_questions: Explain the role of the thermal battery in torpedo propulsion.
Describe how the control system directs the torpedo's path.
Identify the primary power source for modern electric torpedoes.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the guidance system suitable for underwater weapons to be discussed in LP 07.
